holder: Ragioneria Generale dello Stato; banca dati gestita da Banca d'Italia
scope: ASL, Province, Regioni comprese le Province autonome e Città metropolitane

inputReceipt.policy: The independently recorded receipt is immutable and verified before parsing; the ETL never replaces expected values with observed input metadata.

ipa.join: Exact SIOPE tax code with one IPA code and one IPA region; no name or fuzzy join.

semantics.validity: Registry validity intersects each observed calendar month.
semantics.absence: No observed movement is null in the compact entity view; an observed zero remains integer zero.
semantics.period: Monthly cash flows are summed; missing months are never imputed and 2026 can be partial.
semantics.geography: IPA region is a legal-seat field, not the physical destination of a payment.
semantics.sanCategories: ASL use four-digit SAN management codes and official labels with temporal validity, not territorial budget titles.
semantics.nonGoals: No all-SSN coverage, addition to accrual-based SSN costs, consolidated public-administration total, pro-capita comparison or ranking.

failClosed: detail, corpus or release-proof reconciliation failure
